answer: To wander into the network, an attacker must fund many wallets and fake credentials, an ivory-tower fable of cheap accounts collapses once each identity costs a slashable deposit and peer vouches. Sybil resistance comes from staking plus proof-of-personhood: each agent locks a bonded stake, and reputation slot attestations are issued by peers who verify real-world uniqueness. Fabricating N identities then costs N stakes plus N vouches, making mass sybil farming economically irrational. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
